footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to KKR: after $3.8B attributable to noncontrolling interests, $119M of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 11.0% to $19.5B in 2025. Operating income fell 4.2% to $24.3B, a 124.7% margin.
Net income fell 26.8% to $2.3B, or $2.34 per share. Operating cash flow was $478M and free cash flow $317M, versus $6.5B; KKR returned $653M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: KKR & Co. Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
